hero.headline: Software & Consulting for Modern Manufacturing
hero.sub: ENCY, P3D Slicer, SolidWorks, DELMIA and CATIA — from a single source, with over 30 years of experience in the DACH region.

products.heading: Our Software Solutions
products.sub: Specialised in CAM, CAD and non-planar 3D printing with robots and 5-axis CNC.
products.sprutcam_desc: Powerful CAM software for milling, turning, wire EDM and robotic machining.
products.p3d_desc: Slicing software for robots and 5-axis CNC — non-planar 3D printing redefined.
products.solidworks_desc: The leading 3D CAD platform for design and product development. Authorised reseller.
products.delmia_desc: Digital factory and robot simulation by Dassault Systèmes. DACH sales partner.

solutions.heading: Solutions by Application
solutions.sub: We advise independently and find the right software for your manufacturing task.
solutions.cnc_desc: From 2.5D to 5-axis simultaneous machining. ENCY or SolidCAM — we choose the best solution for your machine.
solutions.robot_desc: Milling, grinding, welding and non-planar 3D printing with industrial robots. Offline programming with ENCY oder P3D Slicer.
solutions.5axis_desc: Program complex simultaneous operations efficiently — with optimised toolpaths and safe collision checking.
solutions.cad_desc: SolidWorks, CATIA and DELMIA for product development, plant engineering and digital factory planning. Training and support included.

cta.heading: Ready to take your manufacturing to the next level?
cta.sub: Get in touch — we analyse your needs and recommend the optimal software solution.
